PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 4 years of production Python experience building scalable REST APIs and microservices. Proficient in PostgreSQL database design, containerization, and CI/CD automation. Seeking to expand into AI systems and LLM integration work.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Backend Engineer, Fintech Solutions Ltd (2021–Present)
Designed and deployed FastAPI microservices handling 500+ requests per second for payment processing platform. Architected PostgreSQL schemas with complex indexing strategies for real-time transaction queries. Implemented comprehensive Docker Compose setups and automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. Mentored junior developers on production Python best practices and code review processes.

Backend Developer, TechVenture Inc (2020–2021)
Built RESTful APIs in FastAPI for SaaS analytics dashboard. Managed PostgreSQL database migrations and optimization for growing user base. Containerized applications and set up automated testing in continuous deployment workflows. Collaborated with frontend team to define API contracts.

Junior Python Developer, StartupHub (2019–2020)
Developed Flask applications for internal tools and customer-facing features. Wrote unit and integration tests. Assisted with Docker container setup and deployment processes.

SKILLS
Languages: Python (expert), SQL, Bash
Frameworks & Tools: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, Linux
Methodologies: Agile, microservices architecture, REST API design

Developed weekend project using open-source language model to automatically summarize news feeds. Implemented vector indexing for semantic search across summaries. Experimented with embeddings and similarity matching for content discovery.

AI ENGINEER

About the Role
We're building the next generation of AI-powered data products and need a backend-focused AI engineer to help us. You'll develop production APIs that seamlessly integrate large language models and embeddings into our platform, working closely with ML researchers and product teams. This role bridges backend infrastructure and applied AI.

Must-Have Requirements
- 3+ years production Python development
- Proven experience building and maintaining production APIs (REST, async frameworks preferred)
- Strong PostgreSQL expertise (schema design, optimization, complex queries)
- Hands-on experience with Docker and CI/CD pipeline implementation

Nice-to-Have
- Experience integrating LLM APIs or working with embeddings and vector databases
- Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems or model evaluation frameworks
- Knowledge of observability tools such as OpenTelemetry or Langfuse for monitoring AI systems
